scenes.say: An FFT ocean for the Entropy engine, computed entirely on the GPU. Here's how it works, in about a minute.
scenes.speak: An F.F.T. ocean for the Entropy engine, computed entirely on the G.P.U. Here's how it works, in about a minute.

scenes.head: Tessendorf's ocean starts from a Phillips spectrum
scenes.say: It follows Tessendorf's model: a Phillips spectrum, shaped by wind, seeds a 512 by 512 grid of wave amplitudes at startup.
scenes.speak: It follows Tessendorf's model: a Phillips spectrum, shaped by wind, seeds a five twelve by five twelve grid of wave amplitudes at startup.

scenes.head: Rotate the spectrum in time, then inverse FFT
scenes.say: Each frame, every wave rotates forward in time, and a 2D inverse FFT, nine butterfly stages per axis, turns it into choppy displacement and foam.
scenes.speak: Each frame, every wave rotates forward in time, and a two D inverse F.F.T., nine butterfly stages per axis, turns it into choppy displacement and foam.

items: Dx / Dz spectra for choppy crests
9 Cooley-Tukey stages per axis, ping-pong textures
Jacobian foam mask where the surface folds

scenes.head: One TypeScript addon, run by an 11-line binary
scenes.say: It's one TypeScript addon with seven WGSL shaders, run by an eleven-line Rust binary outside Entropy Studio.
scenes.speak: It's one TypeScript addon with seven W.G.S.L. shaders, run by an eleven line Rust binary outside Entropy Studio.

scenes.head: 21 compute dispatches per update
scenes.say: That's 21 compute dispatches per update, and on integrated Intel graphics it held 120 updates a second, locked to vsync.
scenes.speak: That's twenty-one compute dispatches per update, and on integrated Intel graphics it held a hundred and twenty updates a second, locked to vee-sync.

visual.label: 2,206 calls in 18.38 s, Intel UHD 770 at 120 Hz
visual.sub: Tracks the 120 Hz display 1:1 (Fifo present mode)

scenes.head: Foam textures don't load outside a Studio project
scenes.say: One limitation: foam textures need a Studio project, so standalone, the foam falls back to a transparent placeholder.

scenes.head: Rivers from the dormant JONSWAP spectrum, then buoyancy and wakes
scenes.say: Next up: rivers, using the JONSWAP spectrum that's already written, then buoyancy and wakes.
scenes.speak: Next up: rivers, using the JON-swap spectrum that's already written, then buoyancy and wakes.
